items.zh: 越是在快要成功的紧要关头，越是不能够掉以轻心。
items.en: The closer it is to success, the less carelessness you can afford.

items.zh: 每当感到沮丧和恐惧时，他会听舒缓的音乐来放松精神。
items.en: Every time depression and fear hit him, he listens to soothing music to calm his mind.

items.zh: 由于天气恶劣，救援物资暂时无法空运至灾区。
items.en: There is no possibility that relief supplies can be airlifted to the affected area at the moment due to severe weather.

items.zh: 当地居民都很喜欢这里，因为这里有粉状的雪和令人叹为观止的景色。
items.en: It's loved by locals and families alike due to the powdery snow and these breathtaking views.

items.zh: 小妹领养的小狗一到家就俘获了全家人的心。
items.en: Upon arriving home, the puppy adopted by my little sister captured the whole family’s hearts.

items.zh: 这位新上任的村官今年最重要的工作就是提倡婚丧从简，推进移风易俗。
items.en: The new village official’s top priority this year is to advocate for simple weddings and funerals and transform outmoded habit and customs.

items.zh: 新发布的机器人不仅胜任秘书工作，并且还能回应使用者的情感需求。
items.en: The newly-launched robot is not only qualified for secretarial work, but also can respond to users’ emotional needs.
